description: Convert an amount between two currencies using official NBP mid rates, cross-rated through PLN. Supports PLN and every currency NBP quotes: table A is used first and table B (exotic currencies, published Wednesdays) is consulted automatically for codes A doesn't carry — each side of the response shows the rate, table and effectiveDate used. Latest rates by default, or historical with date. NBP publishes only on Polish business days — on weekends/holidays the request falls back to the most recent preceding publication; effectiveDate in the response shows the date actually used.

amount.description: Amount in the source currency to convert.

date.description: Optional historical date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for the latest rates.

from.description: Source currency code (e.g. USD, PLN). Case-insensitive.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh NBP fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

to.description: Target currency code (e.g. EUR, PLN). Case-insensitive.

name: nbp_convert
title: Convert currencies via NBP rates
